events.title: First Roots
events.what_happens: Pip and the other colonists carefully anchor a tiny seedling to the desk's edge. Sunlight catches the dew on its leaves, making them shimmer like glass as they settle into place.
events.colonist_says: Look! It's drinking the light already. It knows we're here.

events.title: Gertie's Treehouse Project
events.what_happens: Gertie starts gathering materials to build a treehouse in the colony's largest tree.
events.colonist_says: I've always dreamed of having a cozy spot up in the trees!

events.title: Morning Sunlight
events.what_happens: The morning sun shines brightly through the window, casting a warm glow over the colony.
events.colonist_says: Good morning! The sun is shining, perfect for a new day of work and play.

events.title: The First Tree
events.what_happens: Luna plants the first tree in the colony, hoping it will grow tall and strong.
events.colonist_says: Let's see how tall this little sapling can grow!

events.title: Morning Planting
events.what_happens: Pip the Packet woke up early and started planting seeds in the dirt near the window. The sun was shining bright and warm, making everything feel good.
events.colonist_says: Good morning! I've planted some new seeds today - they're so tiny but they'll grow into big, strong trees! Can you help me water them?

events.title: The First Bloom
events.what_happens: The first sunflower seed sprouts and begins to stretch toward the light.
events.colonist_says: Look! The seed has awakened! Let's sing it a lullaby to help it grow.

events.title: The River in the Desk
events.what_happens: Pip kneels at the edge of the desk, traces a long hairline crack with a fingertip, and announces it is a river. By the time the light hits the shelf, Pip has built a wobbly three-plank bridge over it and is already sketching the tributaries.
events.colonist_says: It's not a crack. It's a river. I've named it. You may not ask the name yet. You may ask it tomorrow.

events.title: The First Cable Car Troubles
events.what_happens: The first cable car, built between the desk and the bookshelf, swayed dramatically in a sudden gust of wind. It almost tipped! Luckily, Barnaby the Builder managed to stabilize it with some clever rope work.
events.colonist_says: Oh dear! That was a bit scary! But Barnaby is so clever!

events.title: The First Day
events.what_happens: Luna wakes up to a bright, sunny morning. She stretches and starts her day by planting seeds in the garden.
events.colonist_says: Good morning! The sun is shining so brightly today. I can't wait to see what new flowers will grow from my seed.

events.title: Planting Day
events.what_happens: Sunny and the other colonists are planting seeds in the garden. They're enjoying the warm sun and the fresh air.
events.colonist_says: It's a great day to start planting! Let's make our garden beautiful!

events.title: The Glass River
events.what_happens: A thin layer of frost forms across the desk edge, turning it into a shimmering, slippery bridge to a dropped crumb on the other side.
events.colonist_says: It looks like a frozen river! But our toes won't grip the ice at all.

events.title: Zap's Flying Adventure
events.what_happens: Zap decides to explore the room by floating through the air, using his curiosity to discover new things.
events.colonist_says: Look out, everyone! I'm flying around! It's like a game of tag in the sky!

events.title: The Puzzle of the Hidden Garden
events.what_happens: Snicker discovers a mysterious puzzle that leads to a hidden garden, but needs the Giant's help to solve it.
events.colonist_says: The Giant, the puzzle is whispering secrets about the hidden garden!

events.title: The Great Berry Bloom
events.what_happens: A patch of Glowberries, previously dormant, suddenly bursts into bloom, covering a section of the desk in vibrant light.

events.title: Zap's Solar Panel Experiment
events.what_happens: Zap sets up a small solar panel on the window sill and starts experimenting with different ways to harness the sun's energy. The colony watches with interest as Zap tries to create a new source of power for the colony.
events.colonist_says: Let's see how much energy we can get from the sun! Maybe we can power our cable cars with it someday.

requests.says: The soil near the shelf edge is a bit tired. Could you sprinkle a little extra seed there? I promise it'll grow tall enough to wave at your coffee mug.
Could you help me find a sturdy ladder for my treehouse project? Thanks!
Hey, can you help me build a cable car? I want to explore the ceiling and see what's up there!
Can you bring a ladder so I can reach the higher branches when the tree grows?
Oh please, can we have some water? My little seedlings are so thirsty and I want to make sure they grow up strong!
Please bring me a glass of water to water the new sprout. Let's make it grow with care!
One seed. Just one. I want to plant it in the river so it becomes a garden, and then I can map the garden, and then the map will be *mine* and not just the desk's.
Could you perhaps move that lamp a little? The sun is quite strong today, and I'm trying to examine this interesting moss I found!
I need some water for the plants in the garden. The sun is so strong today, they'll dry out quickly if I don't take care of them!
Hey, could you help me find a spot for my new plant? I want it to have some shade to grow better.
Giant, could you lean that ruler against the sill? We need a bridge to cross the glass stream safely.
Can you build me a cable car? I want to see the whole room from up high!
I need a ladder to reach the highest branch where the puzzle is hidden!
Giant, could you please cast a little shadow over the Glowberries? They're getting a bit *too* bright!
Hey Giant, could you help me find a spot with some shade? I'm working on my solar panel experiment and need a bit of protection from the sun.
